verdict.rationale: Gemini API has rate-limit tiers and pricing docs (gemini-docs-17,18,31) that could theoretically bound spend, but there is no documented hard spending cap, and multiple independent reports show the closest mechanism—GCP budget alerts—failed to prevent runaway bills: one user got a surprise $6,909 charge from a leaked key, another saw budget/anomaly alerts fire hours late while costs ballooned from a €80 alert threshold to €54,000+, and a third explicitly states 'there is no easy way to set a hard cap on billing on a project for the Gemini API.' Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a true hard spend cap or auto-shutoff, and evidence that alerts trigger before overage occurs.
